name: Aparthotel Schindlhaus
beschreibung: The Aparthotel Schindlhaus in Tyrol is nestled in a tranquil setting on the edge of world-renowned Kitzbühel. It offers comfortable apartments featuring a kitchenette, living and sleeping quarters, and a private balcony. A fresh breakfast service is available upon request, alongside convenient ski storage for winter sports enthusiasts. Guests enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi access and private parking facilities. The property serves as a superb launchpad for scenic alpine hikes and top-tier ski slopes. Each apartment comes equipped with satellite TV and a microwave. This aparthotel is the ideal address for self-catering guests looking for complete flexibility.
